game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Pipeline: Chain one function's output into the next to push hot soup pots down a processing line.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Chain one function's output into the next to push hot soup pots down a processing line. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the pipeline value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the chapel bell using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The chapel bell reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the chapel bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Function Pipeline
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Pipeline' (Week 6 slot 5), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Sleigh Stables'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how pipeline changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Sleigh Stables.
